title: Shared Between Two Lists
statement:
Two clubs each keep a membership list sorted by member ID, and an ID may appear several times within one list. Count how many different IDs appear in both lists.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `m`, the lengths of the two lists. The second line contains the `n` IDs of the first list in non-decreasing order. The third line contains the `m` IDs of the second list in non-decreasing order.

## Output
Print the number of distinct values that occur in both lists.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n, m <= 50000`
- `0 <= value <= 10^9`
